taxable_transportation_zone_miles.description: Maximum distance from the nearest point on the continental U.S. boundary of a place in Canada or Mexico where taxable air transportation can begin or end (the zone named after this distance).

registration_exception_max_maturity_year.description: Maximum maturity at issue of an obligation that is not a registration-required obligation for that reason.

rate_increase_safe_harbor_min_deposit_pe.description: Minimum deposit for each semimonthly period, as a percent of the look-back quarter's tax liability refigured at the increased rate, for the safe harbor rule to apply after an increase in the rate of tax.

domestic_segment_tax_per_segment.description: Dollar amount of the domestic-segment tax for each segment of taxable air transportation.
